fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on projected 2011 fuel usage, such an increase would result in an increase to Aircraft fuel expense of approximately $502 million in 2011, inclusive of the impact of effective fuel hedge instruments outstanding at December 31, 2010

instrument_type_details.notes: Primarily heating oil option and collar contracts as cash flow hedges (NYMEX Heating oil). As of December 31, 2010: 31 million barrels of jet fuel outstanding, to be settled over next 24 months (2011-2012). As of January 2011: 35% of 2011 fuel requirements covered; collars represent ~30% of 2011 requirements. Cap price: ~$2.52/gal jet fuel; floor price: ~$1.92/gal. Net fair value: $257M at Dec 31, 2010 (excluding December settlement payable). FY2010 net losses: $(142)M; FY2009: $(651)M; FY2008: $380M gains.

warnings: pct_hedged_current_year=35 is as of January 2011 (not Dec 31, 2010), per Item 7A: 'As of January 2011, the Company had cash flow hedges, with collars and options, covering approximately 35 percent of its estimated 2011 fuel requirements.'
volume_gallons_millions=null: Note 7 discloses 31 million barrels (not gallons) across next 24 months; equivalent to approximately 1,302 million gallons total for 2011-2012.

net_fair_value_mm=257: Note 7 text states '$257 million' at Dec 31, 2010, excluding payable for contracts that settled in December. Balance sheet shows $269M current asset - $0 liability = $269M gross.
FY2010 net losses on fuel hedges: $(142)M recognized as component of Aircraft fuel expense (including ineffective portion).
Collars represent ~30% of 2011 fuel requirements; options (calls) represent the remaining ~5% of the 35% total hedge.
